skills.name: Bat Strike (蝠击)
skills.line: From now on, you're my prey.
skills.description: SP Vampira summons 1 Bat to attack an enemy, dealing damage equal to 75% of ATK and inflicting 100% HP Steal. ;Gnaw (喰噬) : :'''General''', '''Mark''' Steals 6% of max HP from enemy shikigami and onmyoji (does not exceed 600% of own starting ATK), lasting 2 turns (up to 10 stacks, exclusive effect) ;Bat (蝙蝠) :Attacks inflict a corresponding stacks of Gnaw. Accumulating 12 Bats will enter the Night Incarnate form.

skills.name: Slumbering Breath (寐息)
skills.line: A captivating crimson night is about to unfold.
skills.description:
Exclusive Effect. Each time max HP increases, SPD increases by 20 and damage taken decreases by 8%, Sustainable for 1 turn (up to 5 stacks).
Active Skill: Recover HP equal to 98% of starting ATK and summon 2 Bats. ;Gnaw (喰噬) : :'''General''', '''Mark''' Steals 6% of max HP from enemy shikigami and onmyoji (does not exceed 600% of own starting ATK), lasting 2 turns (up to 10 stacks, exclusive effect) ;Sustainable (维持) :Represent the turns a status or a mark lasts is counted by its source rather than its target. ;Recover (恢复) :Different from Healing. Unaffected by Heal Down effects. Does not trigger effects related to healing, and cannot land Crits. ;Bat (蝙蝠) :Attacks inflict a corresponding stacks of Gnaw. Accumulating 12 Bats will enter the Night Incarnate form. ;Night Incarnate (此身即夜) :Upon entering, upgrades Bloodmoon Veil to Moonclipse Crown, removes all controlling effects, and immediately casts Moonclipse Crown once without orb cost. When dealing damage, if the enemy's HP is lower than her own HP, deals an additional 0.3% for every 1% HP difference. ;Remove (解除) :Removes effects that cannot be dispelled.

upgrades.text: When an enemy non-summoned entity's HP drops by more than 25%, summons 1 Bat to attack the enemy.
When a non-summoned entity ally is KO'd, summons 2 Bats to attack the damage source.
After being attacked, summons 1 Bat to attack the damage source.

skills.name: Bloodmoon Veil (月染幽红)
skills.line: Fly freely, for we are the night
skills.description:
SP Vampira summons 3 Bat to attack an enemy target 3 times, each strike dealing damage equal to 75% of ATK, while inflicting 100% HP steal. ;Gnaw (喰噬) : :'''General''', '''Mark''' Steals 6% of max HP from enemy shikigami and onmyoji (does not exceed 600% of own starting ATK), lasting 2 turns (up to 10 stacks, exclusive effect) ;Bat (蝙蝠) :Attacks inflict a corresponding stacks of Gnaw. Accumulating 12 Bats will enter the Night Incarnate form. ;Enshyoujo (飞缘魔) :Unable to take action, does not trigger Soul effects or passive skills, with HP equal to 50% of SP Vampira's HP. If only Enshyoujo remain on the enemy side, counts as a battle victory. This effect can only trigger once for the same shikigami.
For each Enshyoujo present, increases the Moonclipse Crown damage dealt to all enemies by 75%, up to 2 stacks.

upgrades.text: When an enemy shikigami is KO'd, summons a Enshyoujo to occupy the enemy spot. (Exclusive effect).

skills.name: Moonclipse Crown (蚀月为冕)
skills.description:
Summons 3 Bats to attack an enemy target 3 times, each strike dealing damage equal to 125% of ATK, and then summons Bat to deal damage equal to 125% of ATK to all enemies. This damage doesn't trigger the target's Soul effects or passive skills, and it inflicts 100% HP steal.
;Bat (蝙蝠)
:Attacks inflict a corresponding stacks of Gnaw. Accumulating 12 Bats will enter the Night Incarnate form.
;Enshyoujo (飞缘魔)
:Unable to take action, does not trigger Soul effects or passive skills, with HP equal to 50% of SP Vampira's HP. If only Enshyoujo remain on the enemy side, counts as a battle victory. This effect can only trigger once for the same shikigami.
For each Enshyoujo present, increases the Moonclipse Crown damage dealt to all enemies by 75%, up to 2 stacks.

bio.condition: With SP Vampira clear any zone 30 times.
